results.name: Cable Row Bar Kneeling Crunch
steps: Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

results.name: Cable Standing Crunch
steps: Use a double handle attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Face away from the cable tower and walk a few steps forward.
Push your hips back, and flex your abs.
Return to the starting standing position and repeat.

results.name: Cable Rope Kneeling Crunch
steps: Use a rope attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

results.name: Cable Rope Kneeling Oblique Crunch
steps: Use a rope attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward then fall into a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

results.name: Cable Bar Kneeling Crunch
steps: Use a bar attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Walk a few steps forward and fall to a kneeling position.
Push your hips back and flex your abs, then push hips forward until in the starting position.

results.name: Cable Bar Standing Crunch
steps: Use a bar attachment and set the cable all the way to the top.
Face away from the cable tower and walk a few steps forward.
Push your hips back, and flex your abs.
Return to the starting standing position and repeat.

results.name: Cable Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

results.name: Cable Rope Standing Crunch
steps: Stand facing cable, hold rope behind head with elbows tucked in.
Brace core and curl torso downward toward hips without pulling with arms.
Return slowly to standing tall, keeping constant tension on abs.

results.name: Cable Standing High To Low Wood Chopper
steps: Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle with both hands overhead.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally down toward opposite hip.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

results.name: Cable Standing Low To High Wood Chopper
steps: Stand sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward toward opposite shoulder.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Hammer Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Use a neutral grip thumb facing up pinky-facing down). Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Pull In
steps: Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

results.name: Cable Twisting Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with a neutral grip. Flex at the elbow. While flexing twist your palm. When you hit the top of the movement your palm should be facing upward.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Reverse Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Seated Bilateral High Curl
steps: Sit between high cables with arms extended outward and palms facing upward.
Curl both handles toward your head while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly straighten your elbows.

results.name: Cable Seated Alternating High Curl
steps: Sit between high cables with your arms extended outward and palms upward.
Curl one handle toward your head while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Slowly extend your elbow, then repeat with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Standing Bilateral Pull In
steps: Stand between high cables, holding the handles in each hand.
Pull both elbows downward and inward toward your sides.
Squeeze your lats, then slowly extend your arms outward.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Pull In
steps: Kneel in between high cables, holding the handles.
Face forward with palms facing upward.
Pull your elbow in toward your rib cage, extend your elbow, then pull with the other arm.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Bilateral Pull In
steps: Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
Kneel in the middle of the cable crossover.
Face your palm up toward the ceiling. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

results.name: Cable Bilateral High Cable Curl
steps: Stand between high cables with arms extended outward and palms facing upward.
Curl both handles toward your head while keeping your upper arms stationary.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly straighten your elbows.

results.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Cable Curl
steps: Stand between low cables
Curl one side by bringing your lower arm across your body. Make sure to keep your upper arm stationary.
Squeeze your biceps, then slowly extend your elbows.

results.name: Cable Pull Around
steps: Place cable pin all the way at the top or nearly at the top of the cable stack.
Face sideways and take a half kneeling position.
Grab the handle and reach across the body, begin the pull.
As you pull, imagine you are trying to put your elbow into your pocket.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Cross Rear Delt Row
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle across your body at opposite side.
Pull handle outward and back, leading with elbow and keeping arm slightly bent.
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Rolling Curl
steps: Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
Take an underhand grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Rolling Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards, as you curl hinge forward.
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Reverse Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set at elbow level.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards, and curl.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Hammer Rolling Curl
steps: Set cable at about elbow level. Stand facing away from the cables and grab handle attachment.
Take a neutral grip, flex your elbows, as you curl hinge forward.
As you extend your elbow, also extend your hips until you are back in a standing position.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Hammer Bayesian Curl
steps: Stand facing away from high cable, hold handle with palm facing inward.
Step forward to create tension and let arm extend fully behind you.
Curl handle toward shoulder, keeping palm neutral, then lower slowly.

results.name: Cable High Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set to about elbow height.
Face away from the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm forward. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Calve Raise
steps: Use a straight bar or ez bar attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom.
Walk a few steps back.
Pull your heels straight up until you feel a contraction in your calves and then back to original position.

results.name: Cable Bar Calve Raise
steps: Use a straight bar or ez bar attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom.
Walk a few steps back.
Pull your heels straight up until you feel a contraction in your calves and then back to original position.

results.name: Cable Belt Calf Raise
steps: Put on a dip belt and attach the cable carabiner to the chain/strap.
Take a few steps back and stand tall. Raise up onto the balls of your feet and hold for a
count.

results.name: Cable Chest Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Pec Fly
steps: Set the cable pin at shoulder height or just above.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
Walk a few steps forward. Then press the weight forward. From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Incline Alternating Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench, cables should be above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

results.name: Cable Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on a bench, holding cables below shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

results.name: Cable Alternating Incline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on an incline bench, holding low cables with palms facing your feet.
Sweep one arm above your chest while maintaining a slight elbow bend.
Slowly lower the handle, then repeat with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Alternating Bench Chest Fly
steps: Lie on bench, hold cable handles above chest, palms facing inward.
Lower one arm outward with slight elbow bend, keeping opposite arm extended.
Bring arm back to center, alternate sides while maintaining controlled movement.

results.name: Cable Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on a bench, holding cables at shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

results.name: Cable Decline Alternating Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench, with cables above shoulder height, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle downward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

results.name: Cable Alternating Decline Bench Chest Fly
steps: Lay on bench with cables above shoulder level.
Start with both arms extended out.
Bring one arm forward and downward, while keeping the other arm in the same position.
Alternate arms until you complete the allotted amount of reps.

results.name: Cable Decline Bench Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lay on bench with cables above shoulder level.
Sweep both handles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles under control.

results.name: Cable Alternating Bench Press
steps: Lie on bench, hold handles beside chest, elbows bent.
Press one handle upward until arm extends, opposite arm remains stationary.
Lower slowly, alternate arms while keeping shoulders stable.

results.name: Cable Standing Svend Press
steps: Stand facing away from low cables, pressing both handles together at your chest.
Extend your arms forward while continuously squeezing the handles together.
Pause briefly, then return the handles toward your chest.

results.name: Cable Push Pull
steps: Stand between cables, holding one handle near your chest and one forward.
Press one arm forward while pulling the opposite elbow backward.
Reverse the movement under control, then switch your stance and arms.

results.name: Cable Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lay on bench with cables at shoulder level.
Sweep both handles in front of your chest while keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Squeeze your chest, then lower the handles under control.

results.name: Cable Decline Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on a bench, holding cables higher than shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

results.name: Cable Decline Chest Fly
steps: Place the cable anchor at a higher level than your shoulders.
Sit on the bench, leave your elbows mostly extended.
Bring your fists together and flex your pecs.

results.name: Cable Incline Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Lie on a bench, holding cables lower than shoulder height with palms facing your feet.
Sweep both handles together above your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause briefly, then lower your arms under control.

results.name: Cable Standing Incline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
Press both handles forward and upward until your arms are extended.
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from low cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward and upward until your arm is extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with slight arm bend.
Bring arm across chest in a smooth arc without rotating your torso.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly to starting position.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at shoulder height, arm slightly bent.
Rotate palm inward and bring arm across chest in a sweeping arc.
Squeeze chest at end range, then return slowly while maintaining internal rotation.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable and hold handle at chest height with elbow bent.
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
Squeeze chest at extension, then return handle slowly to starting position.

results.name: Cable Incline Fly Around
steps: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Fly arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

results.name: Cable Incline Press Around
steps: Set cables slightly below shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and upward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

results.name: Cable Decline Press Around
steps: Set cables slightly above shoulder height and step forward into staggered stance.
Press arm forward and downward in an arc, finishing slightly across your torso.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Incline Chest Fly
steps: Stand between low cables with arms extended and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle upward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Incline Chest Fly
steps: Stand between low cables with your arms extended outward.
Sweep one handle upward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Chest Fly
steps: Stand between cables with arms extended outward and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle across your chest while maintaining a slight elbow bend.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Fly
steps: Stand between cables, hold cable handles above chest, palms facing inward.
Lower one arm outward with slight elbow bend, keeping opposite arm extended.
Bring arm back to center, alternate sides while maintaining controlled movement.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Internally Rotated Decline Chest Fly
steps: Stand between high cables with arms extended and palms facing downward.
Sweep one handle downward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Fly
steps: Stand between high cables with your arms extended outward.
Sweep one handle downward and across your chest with a slightly bent elbow.
Slowly return, then repeat with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Decline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward and downward until your arm is extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Standing Decline Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from high cables with handles beside your chest.
Press both handles forward and downward until your arms are extended.
Squeeze your chest, then return the handles under control.

results.name: Cable Standing Alternating Chest Press
steps: Stand facing away from the cables with handles beside your chest.
Press one handle forward until your arm is fully extended.
Return under control, then press with the opposite arm.

results.name: Cable Wrist Extension
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a
degree angle with your palm facing down. Flex and extend at the wrist.

results.name: Cable Wrist Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Start with your elbow at a 90° angle with your palm facing up. Flex and extend at the wrist.

results.name: Cable Bar Reverse Grip Curl
steps: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face the cable machine.
Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support. Face your palm down. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Seated Bayesian Reverse Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine and sit on the bench. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Reverse Bayesian Curl
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine. Stagger your stance so you have a better base of support.
Face your palm downwards. Flex at the elbow and extend.

results.name: Cable Braced Wrist Curl
steps: Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm up holding handle.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in forearm flexors.
Curl wrist upward, squeezing forearm at the top.

results.name: Cable Braced Wrist Extension
steps: Stand facing cable, brace forearm on support with palm down holding handle.
Lower wrist slowly to feel stretch in top of forearm.
Extend wrist upward, contracting forearm extensors fully.

results.name: Cable Overhead Press
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine. Stand upright making sure to maintain a flat back. Your starting position will have your palms facing forward.
Use both your elbows and shoulders to press the weight directly overhead.

results.name: Cable Low Single Arm Lateral Raise
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arm straight out to the side.
Raise until your arm is parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Upright Row
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.

results.name: Cable Y Raise
steps: Stand over crossed low cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Raise your arms upward and outward, forming a Y shape.
Pause near overhead, then slowly lower the handles.

results.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Upright Row
steps: Stand between crossed low cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Pull both handles upward, leading with your elbows.
Stop near chest height, then lower the handles slowly.

results.name: Cable Thruster
steps: Hold low cable handles at shoulder height with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down while keeping your chest raised and knees tracking outward.
Stand powerfully and press both handles overhead until your arms are extended.

results.name: Cable Behind The Back Lateral Raise
steps: Place the cable all the way at the bottom and stand with the cable crossing behind your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.

results.name: Cable Standing Single Arm Incline Chest Press
steps: Stand sideways to cable with handle set low, holding it at chest height.
Press handle upward and forward at a slight diagonal, keeping torso stable.
Squeeze chest at the top, then return slowly to starting position.

results.name: Cable Internal Rotation
steps: Stand tall, hold the cable handle with a neutral grip, your elbow should be at a
degree angle.
Rotate your shoulder by bringing your forearm across your body.

results.name: Cable Rope Upright Row
steps: Use a rope attachment with the cable set to the bottom of the machine.
Pull your elbows straight up toward the ceiling until the attachment is just below your chin then extend until your elbows are fully extended.

results.name: Cable Rope Front Raise
steps: Face away from the cables. Use a rope attachment.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

results.name: Cable Rope Mid Lateral Raise
steps: Place the cable at the same height as your fist when your arms are at your side and stand with the cable crossing your body.
While keeping your elbow mostly extended, lift your arm until it's parallel with the floor.

results.name: Cable Rope Single Arm Low Lateral Raise
steps: Use a rope attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Bar Front Raise
steps: Face away from the cables.
With your elbows extended raise your fists straight up to the ceiling until they are at eye level.

results.name: Cable Low Bilateral Lateral Raise
steps: Use a handle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
You should vertically abduct at the shoulder raising your arms straight out to the side.
Raise until your arms are parallel with the ground and then back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Decline Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set above height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cables should be set to shoulder height.
Bring both of the handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Decline Single Arm Bench Press
steps: Use a handle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set above shoulder height.
Bring one handles to your chest and make sure you are in the center of the cable crossover.
From there, you should flex and extend at both the shoulders and elbows simultaneously.

results.name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Glute Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to the bottom of the crossover machine.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

results.name: Cable Bar Romanian Deadlift
steps: Start with a straight bar or ez bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

results.name: Cable Goblet Squat
steps: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
Get your elbows directly underneath the bar, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
Squat all the way back to a standing position.

results.name: Cable Standing Hip Abduction
steps: Use an ankle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Face sideways with the ankle attachment on your outside leg. Walk a few steps away.
Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of your foot touching back to the ground (to keep tension on the muscle).

results.name: Cable Split Squat
steps: You can use a straight or EZ bar on this exercise. Cable should be set all to the bottom.
Grab the attachment and walk back a few steps. Take a split stance. One leg in front and one behind.
Break at the knees and hips to initiate the split squat. Make sure your back knee touches the floor.
Squat back up into a standing position.

results.name: Cable Single Leg Deadlift
steps: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.
Push your butt back to initiate the movement while lifting one of your legs. Then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
Compete your given amount of reps, then switch to opposite leg.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back.

results.name: Cable Pull Through
steps: This exercise works best with a rope attachment but can be done with anything. The attachment should be set to the bottom of the machine.
Face away from the cable machine, straddle the cable itself, and grab the attachment. Walk a few steps away.
Break at the hips while maintaining a flat back and mostly extended knees.
Push hips forward until you are back in a standing position.

results.name: Cable Belt Squat
steps: Put on a dip belt. Attach the strap/chain to the cable's carabiner.
Take a few steps back. Begin to squat by flexing at the knees and hips.
Let the weight pull you forward as you squat. Then push your toes through the front of your shoes as you squat back to the start position.

results.name: Cable Belt Split Squat
steps: Put on a dip belt and attach the strap/ chain to the cable's carabiner.
Take a few steps back and take a split stance.
Lower into a split squat, letting the weight pull you forward. As you squat back to the starting position push yourself backwards against the resistance.

results.name: Cable Elevated Deadlift
steps: Start with handles set to the bottom of the machine. Grab a box, stand on top of the box, squat the weight up into a standing position.
Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

results.name: Cable Bar Staggered Romanian Deadlift
steps: Start with a straight bar attachment set to the bottom of the machine. Squat the weight up into a standing position and walk a few steps back.
Stand with a staggered stance. Push your butt back to initiate the movement and then push your butt forward until you're back in a standing position.
To protect yourself from injury, always maintain a flat back on any exercise.

results.name: Cable Zercher Good Morning
steps: Begin by standing with your feet about hip-width apart and holding the bar in the crook of your elbows, with your palms facing towards your body.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, bend at the hips and lower your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the ground.
Push through your heels to extend your hips and raise your body back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Standing Glute Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to the bottom of the crossover machine.
Break at the knee, push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

results.name: Cable Standing Straight Leg Mid Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set to halfway up the crossover machine.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

results.name: Cable Standing Mid Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. The cable should be set halfway up the crossover machine.
Start with a bent knee position. Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

results.name: Cable Standing Hip Adduction
steps: Bring the cable all the way to the bottom of the stack. Use an ankle attachment.
Keeping your feet together, move your legs out to the sides and then back to the midline of your body. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.

results.name: Cable Bench Straight Leg Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. The cable should be set to hip height.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

results.name: Cable Incline Bench Straight Leg Kickback
steps: Use an ankle attachment. Bring a bench over to the cables. Put the bench at incline level. The cable should be set to shoulder height.
Push your ankle straight back, extending at the hip. Hold for a one count when you feel a contraction in your glutes.
Then flex at the hips until you are back into your original position.

results.name: Cable Quadruped Hip Abduction
steps: Use an ankle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Take a quadruped position with the cable going across your planted leg.
Abduct at the hips and raise your leg out to the side.
Return to the starting position and stop just short of the cables touching back down (to keep tension on the muscle).

results.name: Cable Hamstring Curl
steps: Use an ankle attachment with the cable set all the way to the bottom of the machine.
Stand upright or try bending slightly forward.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.

results.name: Cable Seated Leg Curl
steps: Bring a bench over to the cable stack, put the cable at head height (when seated). Use an ankle attachment.
Sit on the bench.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.

results.name: Cable Single Leg Laying Leg Curl
steps: Bring a bench over to the cable stack, put the cable all the way at the bottom. Use an ankle attachment.
Lay on the bench.
Flex at the knee and pull your ankle straight back.

results.name: Cable Bent Over Bar Pullover
steps: You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.

results.name: Cable Lat Prayer
steps: You can use any attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

results.name: Cable Standing Bilateral Straight Arm Pull In
steps: Stand between high cables with both arms extended outward.
Pull the handles downward and inward while keeping your elbows nearly straight.
Squeeze your lats, then slowly return to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Straight Arm Pull In
steps: Kneel between high cables, holding the handle with your outside arms extended.
Face your palms downward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Alternating Straight Arm Pull In
steps: Kneel between high cables, holding the handle with your outside arms extended.
Face your palms downward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage. Alternate sides with each rep.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Lat Prayer
steps: Use handle attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ear should be even with your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulder and not your elbow. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

results.name: Cable Kayak Row
steps: Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Bring one arm to your side.
You can either alternate sides or do one side at a time.

results.name: Cable Rope Pullover
steps: Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward somewhat.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. Imagine trying to pull the attachment through your thighs at the bottom.

results.name: Cable Rope Lat Prayer
steps: Use a rope attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Grab your attachment and walk a few steps back. Push your butt back to where you are leaning forward. Your ears should be between your arms.
Initiate the movement with your shoulders and not your elbows. As you flex at the shoulder joint push your hips forward until your hips meet the attachment.

results.name: Cable Straight Arm Pull In
steps: Use a handle attachment set all the way to the top of the cable crossover machine.
Walk a few steps away from the cable machine. Face your body sideways.
Face your palm forward. Then pull your elbow in toward your rib cage.

results.name: Cable Archer Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height.
On the same side as the working arm, step back and rotate outwards.
Pull your elbow back while flaring your elbow out.

results.name: Cable Supinating Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height.
Start with an overhand grip. As you pull your elbow back, rotate your palm until it faces upward.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Neutral Grip Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm toward the midline of your body.
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Underhand Grip Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a handle attachment. Face your palm upward.
Pull the handle back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handle towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

results.name: Cable Zercher Squat
steps: Start with a straight bar or easy bar attachment .
Place the bar in your elbows, squat straight up and then walk back a few steps.
Break at your knees and hips to initiate the squat. Make sure you maintain a flat back.
Squat all the way back to a standing position.

results.name: Cable Pallof Press
steps: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then pull the handle back to your chest.

results.name: Cable Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at about nipple level. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Half Kneeling High To Low Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable just over your head. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Half Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at a low position. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Half Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Set the cable at nipple level. Take a half kneeling position. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, then rotate your torso with your arms extended against the resistance.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Oblique Pushdown
steps: Set the cable just over your head. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, push the handle down until your elbow is extended. Flex your obliques until you feel a contraction.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Pallof Press Rotation
steps: Use a handle attachment, set the cable at nipple level, walk a few steps away, and face sideways.
Start with both hands on the handle and your fists against your chest.
Press the handle forward until your elbows are fully extended, then rotate away from the cable stack.
Then pull the handle back to your chest.

results.name: Cable Side Bend
steps: Set the cable at the bottom of the stack. Use a handle attachment.
Face sideways, grab the handle, lean away from the cable.
After completing your given number of reps, face the opposite direction and repeat.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Low To High Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and grasp handle near hip level with both hands.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally upward across body toward opposite shoulder.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Oblique Crunch
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and hold rope behind head, elbows pointed out.
Crunch torso toward hip on cable side, keeping hips stable.
Slowly return to upright, maintaining constant tension on obliques.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Pallof Press
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and hold handle at chest, elbows tucked.
Brace core and press handle straight forward without rotating torso.
Hold briefly, then return handle to chest under full control.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Pallof Press To Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and press handle straight forward, keeping torso stable.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body into a wood chopper motion.
Return to center and bring handle back to chest under control.

results.name: Cable Kneeling Wood Chopper
steps: Kneel sideways to cable and grip handle with both hands in front of chest.
Rotate torso and pull handle diagonally across body in a smooth arc.
Control the return, keeping core braced and hips stable.

results.name: Cable Standing Leg Extension
steps: Stand upright facing away from the cable crossover with the cable set to the height of your hips. Use an ankle/wrist attachment.
Extend at the knee against the cable.

results.name: Cable Seated Leg Extension
steps: Use an ankle/wrist attachment. Pull the cable under the bench and attach it at your ankle.
Extend at the knee against the cable.

results.name: Cable Rope Face Pulls
steps: Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Cable High Single Arm Rear Delt Fly
steps: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Rear Delt Row
steps: Use a handle attachment, grab with an overhand grip and take a position with the cable crossing your body.
Pull your elbows back while flaring your elbows outward.

results.name: Cable Rope Kneeling Face Pull
steps: Start with the cables at the top. Use a rope attachment. Fall to a half kneeling position.
Pull the metal piece in the middle of the rope to the bridge of your nose.

results.name: Cable High Reverse Fly
steps: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arm.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Internally Rotated High Reverse Fly
steps: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
From there, your shoulder should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable High Internally Rotated Reverse Fly
steps: Use a handle attachment or no attachment at all. The cable should be set to the top.
Walk a few steps away with the cable coming from the opposing side of the working arms. Internally rotate the shoulders.
From there, your shoulders should horizontally abduct and adduct, while your elbows stay in a fixed position.

results.name: Cable External Rotation
steps: Hold the cable handle in one hand, elbow bent at
degrees going across your torso.
Rotate your arm outward, keeping your elbow stable.

results.name: Cable Bar Face Pull
steps: Facing the pulley, pull the weight towards you while keeping your arms parallel to the ground.
Pull your hands back to both sides of your head and hold the position.
Slowly return weight to starting position. Repeat.

results.name: Cable Seated Bar Face Pull
steps: Sit facing cable machine and grasp bar with shoulder-width overhand grip.
Pull bar toward upper face while driving elbows outward and back.
Squeeze rear delts at the end, then return bar slowly with control.

results.name: Cable Seated Rope Face Pull
steps: Sit facing cable and hold rope with palms facing each other, arms extended.
Pull rope toward upper face while flaring elbows outward.
Squeeze rear delts and mid-traps, then slowly return to start.

results.name: Cable Seated Single Arm Face Pull
steps: Sit facing cable and hold handle with arm extended at shoulder height.
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
Squeeze rear delt, then return slowly, maintaining control.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Face Pull
steps: Stand facing cable and hold handle at shoulder height with arm extended.
Pull handle toward upper face while driving elbow outward and back.
Squeeze rear delt at the end, then return slowly with control.

results.name: Cable Silverback Shrug
steps: Use a bar attachment. Cable should be set all the way to the bottom.
Stand up with the attachment in hand, walk a couple of steps back make sure you are standing upright and not leaning backwards.
Retract your shoulder blades and then protract to return to the starting position.

results.name: Cable 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Use a handle attachment on both sides of crossover. With cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab both handles and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arms hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blades up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blades depress back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Single Arm 30 Degree Shrug
steps: Use a handle attachment. With the cable attachment set all the way to the bottom.
Grab one handle and make sure you are centered in the machine. Let your arm hang freely.
Pull your shoulder blade up and in towards your ears. Let your shoulder blade depress back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Row Bar Standing Row
steps: Place the cable at shoulder height. Use a row bar.
Pull the handles back using your arms. Push out your chest.
Pull the handles towards your body until your hands are beside your abdomen.

results.name: Cable Rope Pushdown
steps: The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbows until you feel your triceps contract.

results.name: Cable Rope Skullcrusher
steps: Use a rope attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Cross Pushdown
steps: Either use two handles or no attachment at all. Both sides of the cable crossover should be set to the top.
Stand in the center of the machine holding each Cable in the opposing hand. Your upper arm should be at a
degree angle with your torso.
Extend your elbows until you feel a contraction and then return to the starting position

results.name: Cable Rope Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: You can use any attachment. The cable should be all the way to the bottom of the machine. Face away from the machine.
Point your elbows straight up toward the ceiling.
From there, extend your elbows until your fists are pointed straight toward the ceiling.

results.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Skullcrusher
steps: Standing between crossed cables, holding opposite handles above your shoulders.
Extend your elbows fully, keeping your upper arms stationary.

results.name: Cable Bilateral Cross Tricep Extension
steps: Stand between crossed high cables, holding the opposite handle in each hand.
Extend both arms downward while keeping your elbows beside your torso.
Squeeze your triceps, then slowly return to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Bar Rolling Pushdown
steps: Stand facing cable holding bar with palms down, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.

results.name: Cable Rope Rolling Pushdown
steps: Stand facing cable holding rope, elbows bent, and shoulders flexed.
First extend your shoulders (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbows.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Rolling Pushdown
steps: Stand facing cable holding handle with palm down, elbow bent, and shoulder flexed.
First extend your shoulder (like performing a pullover), then extend the elbow.

results.name: Cable Bar Skullcrusher
steps: Use a bar attachment. The cable should be set all the way to the top of the machine.
Face away from the machine with your elbows up and the attachment just behind your head.
Extend at the elbows until you feel a contraction in your triceps and then flex at the elbow back to the starting position.

results.name: Cable Bent Over Single Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
steps: Face away from cable, hinge at hips, and grasp handle behind head.
Keep upper arm still and extend elbow until arm is straight.
Squeeze tricep at the top, then slowly return to starting position.

results.name: Cable Single Arm Pushdown
steps: Use a handle attachment. The cable should be set all the way at the top of the machine.
Make sure to keep your upper arm glued at your side. Extend your elbow until you feel your tricep contract.

results.name: Cable Leaning Single Arm Skullover
steps: Stand in front of cable stack facing away to and lean torso slightly forward, holding handle overhead.
Break at the elbow until your forearm touch your bicep, then flex at the shoulder joint bringing your upper arm to the side of your head.
Bring your elbow back forward, then extend your elbows.
